answer: An agent economy can require each new identity to post a stake that is slashed when it double-signs a transaction or is proven to endorse conflicting claims. A grove of independent validators checks those proofs, while a violet reputation mark records prior slashing and a prism of diverse agents helps limit collusion. Creating many identities does not multiply influence for free: the attacker must lock capital in every identity and risks losing it when misbehavior is verified.
